name: CanalYar Channel Posts for Telegram, Bale and Rubika
author: Milad Kardgar

sections.description:
CanalYar turns any WooCommerce product into a ready-made channel post — name, product code, price (with the old price struck through on sale), colors, attributes, your support ID and a buy link — and posts it with the product images to your channels on Telegram, Bale and Rubika, and as an Instagram post, story or both.

This plugin is the WordPress side of the CanalYar service (canalyarr.ir). Posts are delivered by the service’s bots, so you need a CanalYar account and connection key. New accounts get a free trial; after that, a paid plan is required. See “External services” below for exactly what is sent.

What makes it different

Usually you have to create a bot for every messenger, paste its token into your site, and — if your server cannot reach Telegram — find a proxy too. CanalYar needs none of that:

  • The bot is ours. You only make our bot an admin of your channel.
  • No token ever enters your site, so there is nothing to leak.
  • No access problems. Our server reaches all the messengers and Instagram; your server does not have to.

One post, not many

Telegram and Bale receive the images as an album with the text as its caption, so every product is a single post. Rubika has no albums, so the main image goes with the text.

It runs by itself

  • Auto send: every product published for the first time is sent to the channels you choose about a minute later.
  • Scheduling and queue: send a post at a set day and hour, or add it to a queue that posts at a fixed gap within the hours you allow.
  • Posts stay current: when a price changes, the channel posts are edited; a product that sells out gets an “Out of stock” label or is removed.

Send anything, not only products

On the Send message tab you can post your own text to the channels, alone or with up to 10 images (an album), a file (PDF, ZIP, …), a song (MP3/M4A, with a music player) or a video (MP4), picked from the media library — up to 30 MB.

One account, with or without WordPress

The same CanalYar account also works without this plugin: in the web panel at canalyarr.ir you can add channels and send text, images, files, music and video from any browser, with no website at all. The plugin adds what only WooCommerce access makes possible — posts built from products, auto send, scheduling and prices kept current. Channels, quota and reports are shared between the panel and the plugin, and developers can use the same key with the REST API.

Channel ownership check

Because the bot is shared, “the bot is an admin” is not enough. When you add a channel, a six-digit code is posted in that channel and you enter it in the dashboard. Until you do, nothing is posted there — so nobody else can post to your channel.

Languages

The plugin is in English with a full Persian (fa_IR) translation included. Channel posts are written in your site’s language, even when your own dashboard language is different.

External services

This plugin does not work without the CanalYar relay service, run by the plugin author at canalyarr.ir. The plugin never talks to Telegram, Bale, Rubika or Instagram directly; everything goes through https://canalyarr.ir/bot-relay/v1, and the service delivers it to the messengers with its own bots.

What is sent, and when:

  • Your connection key — with every request, to identify your site.
  • Account status — when you open the CanalYar settings page or the send window, the plugin asks for your plan, usage and channels (cached for 5 minutes). Only the key is sent.
  • Channels — when you add, verify, test or remove a channel: the messenger, the channel username or ID, the verification code, and (for a test message) your site name.
  • Posts — when you send a product (by hand, by auto send, on a schedule or from the queue): the post text, the target channels, the image mode and the product images (as file uploads).
  • Messages — when you send a message from the “Send message” tab: the text, the target channels and the attachment you picked from the media library (images, or one file, song or video, as a file upload).
  • Post updates — when a sent product’s price or stock changes (if you turned this on): the channel, the message IDs and the new text, or a delete request.
  • Instagram — for an Instagram account connected in the CanalYar panel, the same post data plus the post/story choice, the product page link (for the story link sticker), the product name and category (story headline and highlight name). The Instagram account itself is connected in the CanalYar panel, never through this plugin; the service then publishes to Instagram on your behalf. Instagram’s terms apply: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870

No customer or order data is ever sent. The service passes post text, images and files on to the messengers and deletes the uploaded images and files after sending; it keeps request logs (time, messenger, status, size, error) for troubleshooting and usage counting.

On some plans, the service adds a short “Sent by CanalYar” line to channel posts. Nothing is added to your website.

  • Terms of service: https://canalyarr.ir/legal.php#terms-en
  • Privacy policy: https://canalyarr.ir/legal.php#privacy-en

Posts delivered to the messengers are also subject to their terms: Telegram, Bale, Rubika.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Sign up at canalyarr.ir/panel with your mobile number (there is a free trial) and copy your connection key.
  3. Go to CanalYar → Connection & subscription and enter the key.
  4. Make the bots shown there admins of your channels with the “Post messages” permission.
  5. On the Channels tab, add each channel and verify it with the six-digit code.
  6. In the product list, click Send to channel — or turn on auto send.

A full guide is on the plugin’s Guide tab.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes. Posts are sent by the CanalYar service, which needs an account and a connection key. New accounts get a free trial.

Can I use CanalYar without this plugin?

Yes. The web panel at canalyarr.ir/panel sends messages with images, files, music or video to your channels without any website. Install this plugin when you want your WooCommerce products posted automatically. Both use the same account, channels and quota.

What can I send besides products?

On the “Send message” tab: any text, alone or with up to 10 images (an album on Telegram and Bale), or one file, song (MP3/M4A) or video (MP4) from the media library, up to 30 MB.

What happens when my subscription ends?

The plugin stays active and your settings and channels are kept; new posts are simply not sent until you renew. Queued posts wait and continue after renewal.

How is the quota counted?

One post or message in one channel is one unit, whether it is sent from the plugin or the web panel. One product in three channels is three units. Quotas reset every month.

Can I change the text before sending?

Yes. The generated text can be edited in the send window, and the overall layout can be changed on the “Post template” tab.

Do I have to send every product by hand?

No. Turn on “Auto send” on the “Channels” tab; new products are sent by themselves or go to the send queue.

What happens to a channel post when the price changes?

It is edited automatically; only the price values in the text change. This covers posts sent with version 1.8 or later.

Auto send or the queue runs late

These tasks run on WordPress WP-Cron. If your site has little traffic or DISABLE_WP_CRON is on, a server cron job must call wp-cron.php every few minutes.
sections.changelog:
1.21.0

  • Product video: a new “Instagram Reel video” box on the product page. In the product send dialog, choose “Reel” to post that video to Instagram as a Reel while the other channels get the product images. “Reel” can also be the default for automatic, scheduled and queued sends.

1.20.0

  • Instagram Reels: a video attachment on the Send message page becomes a Reel (up to 90 seconds, 9:16 frame); Reels have their own daily limit in each plan.

1.19.0

  • New option in “Keep posts up to date”: post an Instagram story when a product sells out (grey photo with a “Sold out” ink stamp, no link) and when it is back in stock (“Restocked” stamp with the product link; the sold-out story is removed).

1.18.2

  • When the page has been open too long (expired security token), the send dialog now says to reload the page instead of “Lost connection to the site”.

1.18.1

  • Fix: the Send message page no longer stops with an error when the CanalYar server cannot be reached.
  • The send dialog warns before sending when fewer sends are left in your quota than channels are selected.
  • The send dialog and the Send message page read fresh usage instead of a five-minute cache.
  • On the free trial, usage is shown for the whole trial instead of this month.

1.18.0

  • Today’s usage and the daily limit are shown next to this month’s usage: in the status bar, on the Subscription card, on the Send message page and in the product send dialog (also after sending).

1.17.0

  • Instagram limits come from your plan (posts and stories per day, and whether highlights are allowed). The send dialog shows today’s Instagram usage, and the highlight option is hidden when your plan has no highlights.
  • readme: Instagram in the description and in “External services”.

1.16.0

  • Instagram: in the product send dialog, choose whether the story also goes into the highlight named after the product category (kept for scheduled and queued sends). The default for automatic posts is a new setting in the post template tab.
  • The free-form message page has a highlight name for the Instagram story (empty: no highlight).

1.15.1

  • Instagram: the default for product posts is now “Post” (a story doubles the sending time and the risk of Instagram limiting the account); change it in the post template tab.
  • Sending waits up to 5 minutes, so a slow Instagram post and story is no longer reported as failed (and re-sent from the queue) while it actually went out.
  • Channels tab: an Instagram account that is still logging in links to the CanalYar panel instead of asking for a six-digit code; Instagram is no longer offered in “Add channel”; the test button for Instagram is “Check connection”.

1.15.0

  • Instagram: choose post, story or both for each send – in the product send dialog, the queue and the free-form message page. The default for product posts is a setting in the post template tab.
  • Instagram now shows by name in channel lists.
  • A story-only product send is still removed when the product sells out.

1.14.0

  • Instagram story after each product post, with a link to the product page (setting “Instagram story” in the post template tab, on by default).
  • Accounts connected with username and password get a link sticker, the story goes into a highlight named after the product category (filter canalyarr_ig_highlight), and the story is removed when the product sells out.

1.13.3

  • Fix: product links with non-Latin (e.g. Persian) slugs were broken in posts sent by hand, because the %xx parts of the address were stripped.
  • Bale now shows text as a clickable text too.

1.13.2

  • The free-form message page now explains the text and ~strikethrough~ formatting.

1.13.1

  • Post template: text turns a text into a clickable link on Telegram (for example Buy on our website); Bale and Rubika get “text: link”. ~Strikethrough~ now also works on Telegram through the shared bot.

1.13.0

  • All internal names (classes, constants, options, hooks, post meta) now use the unique prefix “canalyarr” instead of “mkc”. Existing settings, send history and queued posts are moved over automatically on update.
  • Developers: the filters are now canalyarr_post_values, canalyarr_post_installments and canalyarr_post_installment_offers.

1.12.2

  • Plugin renamed to “CanalYar Channel Posts for Telegram, Bale and Rubika” (WordPress.org does not allow “WooCommerce” in plugin names).

1.12.1

  • Plugin renamed to “CanalYar Channel Posts for Telegram, Bale and Rubika” to make clear it is a third-party integration.

1.12.0

  • New post placeholder {base_price_number}: the base price without the installment markup, number only (filled by the cash and installment pricing plugin; otherwise the same as {price_number}). Price sync updates it in earlier posts too.

1.11.3

  • Send queue: posts keep to their time slot, so with a daily gap they go out at the same hour every day instead of drifting later.

1.11.2

  • Send queue: the gap between two posts can now be 1, 2 or 3 days or a week.

1.11.1

  • Documentation: the same account works from the canalyarr.ir web panel without WordPress; new FAQ entries about sending messages and files.

1.11.0

  • Send queue: choose which days of the week the queue may post on.

1.10.1

  • Fix: scheduling a send for a set time was rejected as “in the past” on sites running a Persian (Jalali) date plugin.

1.10.0

  • New “Send message” tab: post any text to your channels, with images, a file, a song or a video from the media library.

1.9.7

  • Server messages follow the dashboard language (English outside Persian dashboards).

1.9.6

  • Update details follow the dashboard language.

1.9.5

  • Persian FAQ in update details.

1.9.4

  • Persian installation guide in update details.

1.9.3

  • Update details are shown in Persian.

1.9.2

  • Plugin name and description are translated into Persian on Persian sites.

1.9.1

  • New CanalYar logo as the admin menu icon.

1.9.0

  • The plugin is now in English, with a full Persian translation included. Channel posts are always written in the site language.
  • Dates follow the dashboard language: Jalali dates and Persian digits in Persian, WordPress dates otherwise.
  • Fix: the “Color attribute” setting on the “Post template” tab had no effect.

1.8.3

  • Guide: link to the API documentation for non-WordPress sites.

1.8.2

  • Full guide to auto send, scheduling and the queue, keeping posts up to date, and panel features on the “Guide” tab.

1.8.1

  • Fix: the send queue counts its gap from the channel’s last post (manual, scheduled or automatic), not only from its own previous post.

1.8.0

  • Channel posts are edited automatically when the price changes.
  • A product that sells out gets an “Out of stock” label (or, if you choose, its posts are deleted); the label is removed when it is back in stock.

1.7.0

  • Scheduled sending: pick a day and hour in the send window.
  • Send queue: posts go out at a fixed gap within allowed hours; auto send can use the queue too.

1.6.0

  • Auto send for newly published products.

1.0.0

  • First release.
